species.real: After the biggest rat clearance ever attempted, South Georgia was declared rat-free in 2018, and the pipits have spread back across the island.
species.name: Tussipit

dex.text: A plain brown songbird who lives in the tussac grass and sings anyway, which is more than the seals can say. Was nearly wiped out by rats, and is quietly delighted to be back.
dex.fact: The South Georgia pipit is the world's most southerly songbird and the only songbird living on the island; it was brought back from the brink after the rats were removed in a project completed in 2018.
